per_case_results.question: Among the sets of cards that have an Italian translation, how many of them have a base set number of under 100?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE NOT T2.translation IS NULL AND T1.baseSetSize < 100 AND T2.language = 'Italian'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*)
FROM "sets"
JOIN "set_translations"
  ON "sets"."code" = "set_translations"."setcode"
WHERE
  "set_translations"."language" = 'Italian' AND "sets"."basesetsize" < 10
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: List all the frame styles and cards Allen Williams worked on and find any banned cards if there are any.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.frameVersion, T1.name, CASE WHEN T2.status = 'Banned' THEN T1.name ELSE 'NO' END FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Allen Williams'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT
  "cards"."frameversion",
  "cards"."name",
  "legalities"."status"
FROM "cards"
LEFT JOIN "legalities"
  ON "cards"."uuid" = "legalities"."uuid"
WHERE
  "cards"."artist" = 'Allen Williams'
LIMIT 500
